chunks: And it was said to the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family: “If only you would set a fixed price for us, for prices rise and fall.” So he, peace be upon him, said:

“I would not meet Allah, the Exalted, with an innovation about which He has conveyed nothing to me. So leave the servants of Allah to benefit from one another. And when you are asked for sincere advice, then offer sincere advice.”

key_terms.اسْتُنْصِحْتُمْ: when you are asked for sincere advice
key_terms.بِبِدْعَةٍ: an innovation introduced without divine sanction

ai.seo_question: Why did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم refuse to set fixed market prices?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم declined to impose price-fixing when asked, stating that he would not introduce a bid'ah not sanctioned by Allah تعالى. It also emphasizes letting people transact naturally while obligating sincerity and honest counsel when advice is sought.
